def process(fraudByPaymentMethod):
    import pandas as pd
    df = fraudByPaymentMethod.copy()

    # Keep rows that look like actual payment methods and have a dollar loss value
    df = df[df['Payment Method'].notna() & df[' Total $ Loss '].notna()].copy()
    df = df[~df['Payment Method'].astype(str).str.startswith('#')].copy()
    df = df[~df['Payment Method'].astype(str).str.startswith('Source')].copy()

    # Parse values like "$2,089M" -> 2089 (millions)
    loss = (
        df[' Total $ Loss ']
        .astype(str)
        .str.replace('$', '', regex=False)
        .str.replace(',', '', regex=False)
        .str.strip()
    )
    loss_m = pd.to_numeric(loss.str.replace('M', '', regex=False), errors='coerce')

    total_m = int(round(loss_m.sum(skipna=True)))
    return pd.DataFrame([{'total_loss_millions': total_m}])
